prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic two-person fashion portrait in a modern living room with a sofa, wood floor, large windows and neutral walls.
prompt.main_subject: Two distinct original approved adult women in supplied outfits and poses. Subject 1 sits upright on the sofa in a navy short-sleeve romper with white V trim, black hosiery, white socks, yellow strappy heels and yellow headband. Subject 2 sits on the floor at the sofa's foot in a red blouse, black shorts, supplied patterned tights and red heels. Preserve distinct faces, natural skin texture and precise pose relationships.
composition_elements: Subject 1 seated on the sofa with feet planted; Subject 2 seated on the floor in the foreground with one leg raised diagonally and one folded for support.
Modern sofa, wooden floor, large windows and neutral walls with bright daylight.
Preserve supplied patterned tights and footwear as attached assets, hand placement, spacing and two-person count.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural window light with gentle fill, realistic floor shadows, bright living-room exposure and polished editorial color.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4:5 group portrait, 35mm lens at f/5.6, sharp faces, clothing, legs and props, realistic skin and fabric texture, subtle grain, no text or watermark.
